Both repeat `mul_pos hγ hδpos` and `uniformScalarDecreaseOn_traceSecondOrderOperator_of_zeroth_lower_bound hδpos.le hcγ`. That is a one-line positivity fact plus an existing lemma. A shared helper would be a thin wrapper, which the rubric excludes.

The expression `hu.1.add upperSemicontinuousOn_const` appears in `ViscositySubsolution.strict_sub_const_of_uniformScalarDecrease` and in the closure-maximizer theorem. It is a one-line call to existing API, so I did not count it.

The many constructor `def`s repeat long hypothesis lists. These are statements, not repeated proofs, and they are not proof machinery.

The remaining theorems are short unpack-and-repack arguments with no substantial shared reasoning. I am fairly confident that no finding meets the rubric's threshold.
